node.title: Re^3: How to send email using Email::MIME & Email::Sender::Simple?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Although I'm not an expert on [mod://PAR], I still suspect it has something to do with all those use lib dirs. I suggest you inspect all of the directories listed in @INC when the program runs (e.g. print "<<$_>>\n" for @INC;) for which versions of [mod://Email::Sender] etc. are installed there. Also, I would suggest just removing all of the use lib dirs from the script, as I don't see a good reason why all the C:\Strawberry ones are there in the first place (and "C:\\Strawberry\\perl\\vendor\\lib\\Email" is almost certainly wrong), and just working with Perl's defaults - that's what [mod://cpanm] will use as well.
